sections.label: Best of the Day
sections.slate: The strongest edges across today's card. Wednesday these went 0-3. Today three separate sources land on the Bears.

straight.reasoning: RG.org, TheSpread and TheLines all pick Chicago. About 72% of bets are on New England, but the line hasn't moved and the Bears' moneyline has gotten shorter, a sign bigger money is on Chicago. New England is missing both starting guards and three cornerbacks, and its road scoring margin is -9.7 (28th). Chicago is +8.3 at home and has averaged 45 points in Caleb Williams' two full games. A 3-point Bears win is a push. Playable at -3 up to -115; skip at -3.5.

Covers and TheSpread both like the Over. Chicago scored 59 and 31 with Williams healthy, and New England has averaged 33.3 over its three-game win streak, with Drake Maye throwing three TDs in each. Both secondaries are depleted, and Chicago is tied for last in yards per play allowed. Risk: the short week. Playable to 51.

parlay.title: Bears Shootout (SGP)
parlay.reasoning: If Chicago's offense rolls like it has with Williams, both legs likely hit together. Correlated, so the book pays less than shown.
